reader_summary.headline: Dan is the founder and CIO of D1 Capital Partners.
reader_summary.overview: Dan is the founder and CIO of D1 Capital Partners. He thinks about markets and businesses constantly, and has built a career entirely around that obsession. He manages over $30B across both public and private markets, with investments in SpaceX, OpenAI and Anthropic.

key_points.text: He manages over $30B across both public and private markets, with investments in SpaceX, OpenAI and Anthropic.
Dan shares the story of the short case he wrote on Orthodontic Centers of America and posted on Value Investors Club.
He shares why he backed Anthropic at a moment when many people told him it was the Lyft to OpenAI’s Uber.
